narrative.overview: SkinLedger looks like a calm measuring instrument you keep in the bathroom, not a beauty brand. The page is paper-white, the type is the system font at reading size, and the only saturated colour is a deep green used where a measurement has produced a judgement. Everything else is ink, rule lines and quiet grey surfaces. The interface has one job per screen and says the uncomfortable thing ("No measurable change", "Too early") in the same weight as the good news.
keyCharacteristics: Paper-white page with near-black ink and one deep-green accent.
Status is carried by a 4-6px left border plus a tinted surface, never by gradients or icons alone.
Pico.css defaults are the substrate: 0.25rem radii, 1rem rhythm, neutral stacked shadow.
Every data point is labelled REAL, SIMULATED or SAMPLE; the disclaimer is always present.

rules.name: The One Judgement Rule
rules.body: Green, amber, red and grey mean a verdict state. They never decorate a heading, an icon or a non-verdict surface.

rules.name: The Paper Rule
rules.body: The page is flat white. Tint appears only when a state changes: verdict cards, SIMULATED banners, form errors and unstable chips.

rules.name: The No New Font Rule
rules.body: No webfont is introduced without resolving the CSP and the offline PWA constraint. The system stack is normative.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: No shadows on buttons, links, inputs or chips. Only article cards carry the neutral card shadow.

dos: Do keep the footer disclaimer verbatim on every page and the exact disclaimer inside the verdict card.
Do keep the REAL / SIMULATED / SAMPLE label on every data point, including chips and cards.
Do use the 4px left spine + wash pattern for any state message; it is the product's one recurring decorative move.
Do keep touch targets at least 44px and body copy at 1rem or larger.
Do use .sl-chip for metadata and keep pills non-interactive.
Do keep aria-live status regions on the capture flow; capture has real waiting states.
donts: Don't introduce a webfont, a new external origin or an inline script; the CSP forbids them.
Don't extend Pico's Action Blue to a new status meaning; it is an inherited default, not a brand signal.
Don't convey a verdict by colour alone; the word and the border must agree.
Don't show or chart ui_score anywhere; the raw score is the only approved number.
Don't add shadows to controls, chips or links.
Don't add brand logos, product brands or medical language.
